{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test R01: Tags validation
try:
    TaggedCache(2).put('a', 1, tags='bad')
    print('FAIL: should reject bare string tags')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: rejects bare string tags')

try:
    TaggedCache(2).put('a', 1, tags=[1, 2])
    print('FAIL: should reject nonstring tag entries')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: rejects nonstring tag entries')

# Test R01: deep copy on get
c = TaggedCache(2)
c.put('a', [1, 2, 3], ['x'])
v1 = c.get('a')
v1.append(4)
v2 = c.get('a')
assert v2 == [1, 2, 3], f'FAIL: deep copy failed: {v2}'
print('PASS: deep copy on get')

# Test R01: deep copy on put
c2 = TaggedCache(2)
data = [1, 2, 3]
c2.put('a', data, ['x'])
data.append(4)
assert c2.get('a') == [1, 2, 3], 'FAIL: deep copy on put'
print('PASS: deep copy on put')

# Test R03: maxsize validation
try:
    TaggedCache(True)
    print('FAIL: should reject bool maxsize')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: rejects bool maxsize')

try:
    TaggedCache(0)
    print('FAIL: should reject zero maxsize')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: rejects zero maxsize')

try:
    TaggedCache(-1)
    print('FAIL: should reject negative maxsize')
except ValueError:
    print('PASS: rejects negative maxsize')

print('All basic checks passed')
"
